All three topics experienced overlapping disruptions, indicating a system-wide disturbance rather than a single root topic failure.
recommended_actions: Investigate system-wide resource constraints or timing issues that could simultaneously affect sensor (/scan), transform (/tf), and actuator (/cmd_vel) data flows.
Check for hardware or OS-level problems (e.g., CPU overload, clock synchronization faults, or I/O bottlenecks) that could induce widespread timing and communication failures.
Review ROS 2 node configurations and network health to ensure robust message delivery and time synchronization across all layers.
Examine logs for any external events (e.g., process restarts, hardware interrupts) around 39–48 seconds that could have triggered the simultaneous anomalies.
